modules.module_title: Analyse data related to energy usage

pcs.pc_description: identify parameters impacting energy usage
perform correlation between energy consumption and the parameters identified to impact energy usage
monitor electrical energy consumption, temperature, Relative Humidity (RH) and air pressure
define threshold for parameters in energy consumption
check all thermostat set points
evaluate costs and benefits of re-piping the facilities
perform thermographic inspection to analyse cold areas where there is poor insulation

modules.module_title: Identify inefficiencies in energy consumption and ways to fix them

pcs.pc_description: separate energy consumption of refrigeration system from the energy used by the whole plant
identify the quantum of undercooling and overcooling during the analysis period
identify the impact of weather conditions on the energy consumed
explore ways to control lighting by daylight sensors and occupancy sensors
identify ways to adjust chiller or refrigeration equipment to achieve better performance
look for ways to promote renewable energy by utilizing bio-waste to generate biogas, wherever possible
improve evaporator performance by looking for ways to reduce fan motor horsepower

modules.module_title: Implement ways to minimize energy inefficiencies

pcs.pc_description: use eco-friendly refrigerants with minimal global warming potential of ozone depleting substances
ensure to pick air cooled condenser or evaporative condenser based on the refrigerant used, size of the system and availability of water
achieve optimal energy usage conditions for the chiller
improve part-load performance for evaporators, condensers and compressors
reduce refrigeration load by checking under- floor heating, insulation levels, warehouse doors usage
reduce load in lighting of the warehouse, by using high efficiency lighting (sodium lights or high frequency fluorescents)
choose energy-efficient lighting and recommend installing skylights, LEDs with sensors (intelligent occupancy sensors, motion sensors, heat maps), etc.
ensure that Lighting Power Density (LPD) does not exceed the required
recommend replacing smart appliances instead of traditional high power consuming standard devices, e.g., HVAC
use machinery and equipment like MHE that runs on electric or alternative clean energy
employ automatic refrigerant leak detection systems
reduce heat load by improving insulation and reducing air leakage
select low power consumed per ton of refrigeration, while upgrading evaporator units
upgrade to high efficiency condenser units, sensor-controlled ventilation systems etc.
use sliding doors instead of traditional freezer doors, which are better insulated, require low maintenance, reduce frost build up, thereby reducing overall energy consumption
use energy efficient PVC strip curtains for the cold storage doors or air curtains, to reduce air exchange during door openings
ensure that the floor heaters are working properly and well protected for the deep freezers

modules.module_title: Prepare and monitor cold room or container for modified atmosphere storage

pcs.pc_description: maintain temperature ranges ideal for the products stored or transported
maintain concentration of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen and ethylene as per the commodities stored
consider product heat and set ventilation to control cooling and carbon dioxide level
monitor composition of gases regularly and accurately
monitor for chilling injury symptoms on the products
ensure to keep the room or container sealed

prepare absorbers and adsorbers of oxygen, carbon dioxide, ethylene and water
